tasks.title: Create ToolCallCard component with tool-specific rendering
tasks.description: Create a new ToolCallCard component in packages/cli/web/src/components/ToolCallCard.tsx that renders tool calls with tool-specific display: edit/write show inline diff (red -/green + lines from rawInput oldString/newString), bash shows terminal block with dark bg and auto-collapse at 10 lines, read/glob/grep/todowrite/webfetch/memread/membrowse/memsearch show collapsed single-line summaries, unknown tools show generic expandable summary. Export helper functions: parseEditInput(rawInput) returning {filePath, oldString, newString}, parseBashInput(rawInput) returning {command}, and a TOOL_DISPLAY_TYPE map categorizing tools.
acceptanceCriteria: Edit tool call with oldString/newString in rawInput renders red/green diff lines with file path header
Write tool call with content but no oldString renders all-green lines (new file)
Bash tool call renders $ command header with monospace dark-bg output, auto-collapses at >10 lines
Read/glob/grep/todowrite tools render as single-line collapsed summary with expand toggle
Unknown tool names render as generic summary with expandable raw input/output
Tool call with state 'started' shows spinning indicator instead of result
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This is a pure presentation component. Import ToolCallEntry type from ../lib/types. No hook dependencies.

tasks.title: Create SessionPage component with breadcrumb and round timeline
tasks.description: Create SessionPage.tsx in packages/cli/web/src/components/. Extract number and sessionId from URL params. Fetch session list via useCoderSessions(issueNumber), find matching session by id. Pass session to useSessionTimeline(issueNumber, session) to get rounds/isStreaming. Render: breadcrumb header (back arrow Link to /issue/:number, issue number, issue title fetched via useIssue), session metadata (stage, model, duration), live indicator when running. Below header, render rounds as conversation cards using a ConversationRound sub-component that shows agent text as prose + tool calls via ToolCallCard. Include 404 state when session not found. Include auto-scroll (scroll container to bottom on round changes, only when within 200px of bottom).
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /issue/:number/session/:sessionId renders the session page with breadcrumb linking back to issue
Session metadata (stage label, model, duration) displays in the header
Running session shows pulsing blue dot with Live label
Rounds render as conversation cards with agent text as prose paragraphs
Tool calls within rounds render via ToolCallCard (edit shows diff, bash shows terminal, read shows summary)
404 state shown when sessionId doesn't match any session in the list
Auto-scrolls to bottom on new content when user is near bottom
Live SSE streaming works: new text/tool calls/rounds appear in real-time
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Reuses existing hooks: useCoderSessions, useSessionTimeline, useIssue. The issue title comes from useIssue(issueNumber). The session stage/model/duration come from CoderSessionItem fields. ConversationRound can be defined inline in this file.

tasks.title: Convert SessionHeader to Link and SessionDetail to summary-only
tasks.description: Modify SessionHeader.tsx: change the outer element from <button> to react-router-dom <Link to={/issue/:number/session/:sessionId}>. Add an issueNumber prop. Remove isExpanded and onClick props (no longer needed). Keep existing visual styling (status icon, label, duration). Modify SessionDetail.tsx: replace the full timeline (RoundSection rendering) with a one-line summary derived from session.workflowLogs — count edit/write events for 'files changed' and all tool_call events for 'tool calls', display as 'N files changed · M tool calls'. Modify SessionList.tsx: pass issueNumber to SessionHeader, remove expandedId state and handleToggle, remove conditional SessionDetail rendering — always show the summary line below each header.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a session header in SessionList navigates to /issue/:number/session/:sessionId
No inline expansion occurs when clicking session header
Each session in SessionList shows a one-line summary like '3 files changed · 5 tool calls'
SessionList no longer has expandedId state or toggle logic
SessionDetail no longer renders full RoundSection timeline
SessionHeader accepts issueNumber prop and renders as <Link>
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This modifies three existing files: SessionHeader.tsx, SessionDetail.tsx, SessionList.tsx. The session page route must exist first (T-003) so the Link targets are valid. SessionDetail's summary computation: iterate session.workflowLogs, count eventType 'tool_call' where data contains edit/write kind for file changes, count all 'tool_call' events for total.
